title: Build Your Value Before You Date
hook: If you're in your 20s, stop chasing women and build your value.
body: Build your body, your money, and your skills, and the women will come later, and they'll be far better than the ones you'd settle for today. I spent a huge amount of time on dating apps and relationships at the exact moment my value was at its lowest, and once I'd made more money and got in better shape in my late 30s and 40s, I was able to attract far higher quality women. Dating is always going to be a struggle until you're ripped and rich, and there isn't any magic technique that makes women attracted to you when you're overweight and broke. But take it from an older man, if you stay on point with your workouts, nutrition, and your work over the next 10 years, you'll attract far better women than you can today.
